hits.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
hits.abstract_snippet: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). hits.title: FlowMoP: Stochastic Multi-Person Motion Prediction
hits.abstract_snippet: Predicting the future motion of multiple people is inherently stochastic: the same observed history admits many plausible continuations depending on intent, coordination, and social context.
